info.title: KU-POTATO HTTP API
info.description: Single-account loopback API. Feature endpoints stream typed results, operation status, and progress using SSE. Replay the feature request to retry.

get.description: Returns SSE status events followed by exactly one result or error event, then closes. Disconnecting detaches observation; execution continues. Repeat the request to observe equivalent active work.

schema.description: auto reads saved data or starts synchronization; false reads only; true starts synchronization.
